name: Living In Fear
overview: Scripture assures believers that God’s presence dispels fear, as He promises to go before us and never forsake us, encouraging strength and courage in all circumstances. The Psalms vividly portray the Lord as our shepherd and light, providing comfort and protection even in the darkest trials, so that we need not fear evil or any adversary. Trusting in the Lord and waiting on Him strengthens our hearts, anchoring us in His steadfast care and salvation.
